assessment_questions: One multiple-choice question in the bank.
assessment_configs: A saved recipe for generating a paper: how many questions, how many coders, the specialty mix and how difficulty is distributed.
generated_assessments: One paper, issued to a named set of coders on a date.
generated_assessment_students: One coder's individual paper, with their questions frozen at generation.
assessment_audit_log: Trainer actions on the assessment module that change a record or a result: deleting an assessment, correcting a graded answer, bulk question changes.
assessment_sessions: One session = one coder taking one generated assessment.
assessment_responses: One row per question answered by a coder — upserted on each answer selection.
charts: A de-identified clinical chart that coders practise on.
audit_logs: What was done to a chart, by whom.
chart_feedback: A problem a coder reported with a chart — an unreadable page, a missing document, a chart that does not match its stated specialty.
chart_sequences: Tracks the last used sequence number per specialty prefix.
answer_keys: Master answer key per chart — permanent, one per chart number.
batches: A unit of assigned coding work: a set of coders, a pool of charts, and the scoring rules to grade them by.
batch_allocation_cycles: One round of chart randomization within an open batch.
batch_coders: A coder on a batch's roster.
batch_charts: One chart assigned to one coder, in one allocation cycle.
submissions: A coder's submitted codes for one chart, from the removed offline Excel workflow.
grading_results: The score for one coder on one chart. The reporting table.
grading_feedback: One specific mistake on one graded chart — what the key said, what the coder wrote, and which kind of error it was.
ed_rubric_details: Per-chart manual rubric grading record for Edits/Denials specialties.
self_practice_submissions: Coder-initiated or trainer standalone grading outside of any batch.
self_practice_results: Per-chart grading result for a self-practice or standalone submission.
scoring_configs: How a specialty type is scored: component weights, pass mark and which scoring methods are enabled.
coding_resources: A reference link a trainer publishes to coders — guidelines, a coding manual, an internal policy page. Display order is manual via sort_order.
em_answer_keys: The answer key for an Evaluation & Management chart. As well as codes, records the medical decision-making elements a coder should have identified — COPA, Data Review and Risk counts — and the complexity level each implies. em_category says which kind of encounter it is, because not every category is levelled by MDM.
em_grading_results: The E/M breakdown behind one graded chart: what the coder submitted for each MDM element, the level derived from it, and the score per component. Linked one-to-one to the grading_results row carrying the headline score.
em_scoring_configs: Weights for E/M grading, held separately because the scheme differs: line 1 is coding accuracy, line 2 is reasoning accuracy. Whichever parts apply to a chart are renormalised to 100 at grading time.
practice_sessions: One coder's access to one allocation cycle's charts. The token is the code a trainer hands out and the only credential a coder needs; there is no login. Keyed per cycle.
practice_chart_drafts: Work in progress on one chart: codes entered but not yet submitted. Saved as the coder types so a lost connection costs nothing. Superseded by practice_results on submission.
practice_results: The graded outcome for one chart in one session, with the feedback shown to the coder. Every row is mirrored into grading_results, which is what all analytics and both PDF reports read.
